title: Up to three category names show, then +N with the full list on hover
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing five new categories made for this test.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, which prices no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at matrix A's +N.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A's Categories cell shows three of its category names, then "+2" (5 − 3 = 2).
  • Matrix B's Categories cell shows "—".
  • Matrix B is still listed.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip lists all five category names.
